roleContext.jobDescription: The logistics delivery services division of a parcel carrier runs its tracking and dispatch services on a cloud platform. The Platform Engineer owns the division's cloud platform end-to-end, decides and executes production infrastructure changes, leads the fortnightly platform change board, and is accountable to the head of engineering for platform cost and availability. The platform hosts the tracking and dispatch services used by every depot, and the role works with four service teams, finance and the security function.

requirements.text: Owns the division's cloud platform end-to-end and decides and executes production infrastructure changes.
Keeps the infrastructure code, the service deployment pipelines and the cost controls in shape.
Chairs the fortnightly change board and keeps its minutes.
Works changes through with the service teams and finance, keeping a record of who decides what.
Keeps runbooks current and notes limitations and hand-over points after every platform change.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Platform Engineer, Logistics Delivery Services

## Experience

- Owned the delivery division's cloud platform (AWS, three accounts) for two and a half years, deciding and executing production infrastructure changes myself as the named platform owner, with each change record carrying my approval and execution.
- Kept the Terraform code, the deployment pipelines for the tracking and dispatch services and the cost controls (account budgets, the tagging policy and a monthly right-sizing pass) in shape.
- Chaired the fortnightly change board with the four service team leads; I decided what went into the production window and kept the minutes.
- Worked changes through with the service teams and finance; the minutes record that service configuration stayed with the service teams, budget approval with finance, and the platform and the production window with me.
- Two and a half years as the delivery division's platform owner: production changes, Terraform, cost controls and the change board.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the service-catalogue page listing the candidate as platform owner and a month of change records approved and executed under the candidate's user id; change-tool identifiers are included so the records can be traced.
